plan.subject: LLM agents

queries.query: ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "large language model agent" OR "autonomous language agent") AND (architecture OR framework OR system OR pipeline)
queries.rationale: Catches general agent-system papers introducing or comparing overall architectures rather than isolated components.

queries.query: ("tool use" OR "tool calling" OR "function calling" OR "API calling") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "large language model agent")
queries.rationale: Targets practical work on how agents invoke tools, APIs, and external functions to complete tasks.

queries.query: ("retrieval-augmented generation" OR RAG OR "agentic retrieval" OR "retrieval-augmented agent") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "large language model")
queries.rationale: Finds papers on agent designs that ground action and reasoning in retrieved documents, memories, or external knowledge.

queries.query: (ReAct OR "plan-and-execute" OR "reasoning and acting" OR Reflexion) AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "large language model")
queries.rationale: Surfaces influential agent patterns that interleave planning, reflection, and action in executable loops.

queries.query: ("multi-agent" OR "multi-agent collaboration" OR "agent society" OR "agent team") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "large language model")
queries.rationale: Captures work where multiple language-model agents coordinate, debate, or divide labor to solve tasks.

queries.query: ("agent memory" OR "long-term memory" OR "episodic memory" OR "memory-augmented agent") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "autonomous agent")
queries.rationale: Finds papers on persistent memory and state management, a core practical issue for longer-horizon agent behavior.

queries.query: ("web agent" OR "browser agent" OR "GUI agent" OR "computer-use agent") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "large language model")
queries.rationale: Targets agents that operate websites, desktop interfaces, or digital environments relevant to real automation workflows.

queries.query: ("code agent" OR "software engineering agent" OR "programming agent" OR "repository-level coding agent") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "large language model")
queries.rationale: Focuses on agent work closest to a software engineer's day-to-day interests: coding, debugging, and repository interaction.

queries.query: ("benchmark" OR "agent benchmark" OR AgentBench OR SWE-bench) AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "autonomous agent")
queries.rationale: Pulls in papers defining or using evaluation setups that reveal what agent systems can reliably do.

queries.query: (hallucination OR "error recovery" OR "failure mode" OR "self-correction") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "autonomous agent")
queries.rationale: Surfaces engineering-relevant work on where agents break and how systems improve reliability in practice.

queries.query: ("self-reflection" OR "self-refinement" OR Reflexion OR "verbal reinforcement") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "large language model")
queries.rationale: Catches agent techniques that use critique, revision, or feedback loops to improve task performance.

queries.query: ("task decomposition" OR "hierarchical planning" OR "subgoal decomposition" OR "plan generation") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "autonomous agent")
queries.rationale: Targets work on breaking complex tasks into executable steps, a major lever for practical agent capability.

queries.query: ("workflow automation" OR "task automation" OR orchestration OR "agent workflow") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "large language model")
queries.rationale: Finds system papers about wiring agents into repeatable workflows and broader software automation pipelines.

queries.query: ("environment feedback" OR "execution feedback" OR "interactive feedback" OR "closed-loop agent") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "autonomous agent")
queries.rationale: Captures agents that improve through observations from tool execution or environment interaction rather than one-shot prompting.

queries.query: ("agent safety" OR "agent alignment" OR "safe agent" OR "oversight for agents") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "autonomous agent")
queries.rationale: Adds coverage for control, oversight, and risk issues that matter when moving agents toward real deployment.

plan.coverage_notes: This plan covers the core practical axes of LLM-agent research: architectures, tool use, retrieval, memory, planning, reflection, multi-agent coordination, interactive environments, coding agents, evaluation, robustness, workflow orchestration, feedback loops, and safety. I biased toward engineering-relevant system and capability questions rather than pure language-model theory, given the reader profile. I skipped very narrow product-specific or library-specific queries because they are low-precision in OpenAlex and less useful for staying current on research ideas.
